occurrence.summary: Both contemporaneous reports describe an executed October 1 anniversary gathering in Baghdad; Shafaq explicitly locates hundreds at Tahrir Square.

location.summary: Shafaq explicitly says central Baghdad Tahrir Square; Al Jazeera covers capital and south but its aggregate number is not pooled.

onset.summary: Both reports identify Oct 1 as the anniversary-day action; not the onset of the 2019 movement.

attendance_threshold.summary: Shafaq reports hundreds at this named Tahrir gathering; above 50.

domestic_state_demand.summary: Participants call for employment/services, accountability of protester killers, transparent elections and political reform directed to Iraqi government.

episode_ownership.summary: The 2020 gathering commemorates 2019 movement and explicitly names Oct25 as another planned date; separate day/action IDs maintained. Neighbor-month movement continuity needs follow-up.

title: Baghdad Tahrir Square anniversary protest and political reform demands
location: Tahrir Square, Baghdad (Green Zone/Allawi Square actions are separate, not pooled here)

occurrence.summary: Contemporaneous reports document actual Oct25 protest action in Baghdad.

location.summary: Al Jazeera reports hundreds marching in Tahrir Square; other assembly points reported separately.

onset.summary: Oct25 date directly stated; this was an anniversary rally distinct in time from Oct1.

attendance_threshold.summary: Al Jazeera says hundreds of protesters marched through Tahrir Square; threshold met at this named site.

domestic_state_demand.summary: Demand accountability for protester killings/kidnappings and broad change to Iraq political class; directed at domestic state.

episode_ownership.summary: Reports describe revival/anniversary of the 2019 movement and continuation of same unmet demands; no merging with October1 or other southern sites.
